episodeTitle.en: 10 lessons on bootstrapping a $200m business | Patrick Campbell (ProfitWell)
episodeTitle.zh: 《如何白手起家打造价值2亿美元的企业 | 帕特里克·坎贝尔（ProfitWell）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Patrick Campbell is the founder and CEO of ProfitWell, which he bootstrapped and sold for over $200 million. In this special episode, we explore 10 big ideas from Patrick, including tips for hiring employees who align with your company values, creating winning pricing and retention strategies, determining the right time to raise money, and more. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to scale your SaaS business, this must-listen episode offers practical and actionable advice that will help you avoid missteps and think differently.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 帕特里克·坎贝尔是ProfitWell的创始人兼CEO，他白手起家将公司卖出超过2亿美元。在这期特别节目中，我们将探讨帕特里克的10大理念，包括如何招聘与公司价值观一致的员工、制定成功的定价和留存策略、确定合适的融资时机等。无论您是初创企业还是希望扩大SaaS业务规模，这期必听节目都将为您提供实用可行的建议，帮助您避免误区，突破思维。

summary.en: The bratty thing here is that real professional ship. At the end of the day, real... I don't care if you're a marketer or a product person, engineer, ops person, people ops, real professional ship, and they ship at a pretty high frequency for whatever they're doing. In my opinion, your tempo framework is more important
summary.zh: 这里关键的是真正的专业精神。归根结底，真正的……无论你是营销人员、产品经理、工程师、运维人员还是人力资源人员，真正的专业精神，他们会以相当高的频率交付成果。对我来说，你的节奏框架更为重要。
